reason: Root cause confirmed in source: packages/prx/src/cli/pilot-real.ts maps tester -> SessionActor 'implement' (roleSessionActor), and openSession dispatches OPEN_IMPLEMENT_SESSION which, for interaction=headless, always builds buildWorkUnitClaudeImplementSdkRuntimeProfile (the EXECUTOR profile: acceptEdits + implement allowlist + 'execute the approved plan ... commit'). The tester leg therefore re-runs the executor over the plan@draft body, reports 'done', and the machine cycles executing->checking->testing until the retreat budget is spent. No tester profile exists in runtime_profiles.ts for the headless path (only a role-string branch in the legacy buildRoleStableSystemPrompt / buildAllowedToolsForRole helpers used by the task-role builder, which openSession never uses).
